A unit trait is a marker class, some taking parameters (e.g. Carries(Air), a defence multiplier), declared per unit class with UnitTraits rules (unitTraits(prefix, UnitClass, ...traits)), so rule sets can supersede them. Queried with unit.hasTrait(T), unit.traits(T), hasTrait/traitsOf(UnitOrClass, T, ruleRegistry) and traitCriterion(T); unitAction accepts trait classes beside unit classes. Traits belong to the class: never saved or sent to clients. Resolved once per class per rule revision; a declaration that asks about its own class throws UnitTraitCycleError. Needs core-rule ^0.1.9 (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).
